newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis makes help for low-wage sector a priority.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis makes help for low-wage sector a priority.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Saturday that a reduction in charges burdening the low-wages sector must be a priority for the ruling centre-right coalition, if it wins the May 25-June 1 parliamentary elections.
Arthuis did not say which charges he was referring to.
He also said that the cuts could be progressively extended to other wages sectors as soon as the state of public finances and economic growth allows.
"Due to our budgetary means we must target the most modest wages and particularly the manufacturing sector," Arthuis said in an interview with Radio Classique.
"We must progressively extend the measures to the whole wages sector," he added.
Arthuis said that low-paid workers in the manufacturing sector were the most vulnerable to possible industry transfers, ,citing the crisis in the textile sector.
The state has already set up an aid plan for the textile sector that involves cuts and other exemptions in social security contributions for low-paid workers.
